summary:
Iteration 3 frontend-only pass on the seeded Riverside Tower project (ed60c71a-2483-4e54-b062-e9414efe35ce). All new spreadsheet-style range editing and undo/redo features work end-to-end. Verified: single-click cell selection + Shift+click rectangular range (highlighted via ring-1 class); keyboard nav (Arrow moves, Shift+Arrow extends); Enter/F2 opens editor; printable-char typing starts edit pre-filled with that char; Ctrl+D fills the top row's value down the selected range and UNSAVED indicator appears; multi-row anchor commit (Enter after fill triggers same value on all rows in range); Delete/Backspace clears editable cells to 0/blank and read-only Successors column is untouched; Ctrl+C shows 'Copied N row(s)' toast; TSV paste event with '88\n99' correctly writes to two rows and shows 'Pasted 2 row(s)' toast; invalid predecessor paste shows 'Invalid link syntax' error toast and does NOT corrupt the target cell; toolbar undo-button/redo-button disabled at load, enable after edits, disable again after Save; Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y / Ctrl+Shift+Z drive undo & redo (verified on Ctrl+D fill, Delete clear, row reorder); Save clears past+future history (both buttons disabled again). Regressions: add-activity-button appends a Z-prefixed row, delete-row-{id} removes it, stage-filter dropdown hides drag handles (reorderEnabled=false), zoom day/week/month, calendar-button opens CalendarDialog, variance-button opens VarianceDialog, theme-toggle swaps html.class dark<->light, versions-button lists 6 snapshots. Backend pytest smoke: 34/34 passed (excluded test_ai.py per brief).

Minor UX bug: onPaste() in DataGrid.jsx unconditionally calls toast.success after apply(); when the paste text fails parseValue (e.g. invalid predecessor syntax) BOTH the 'Invalid link syntax' error toast and 'Pasted 1 row(s)' success toast are shown together. Data is not corrupted (fix applied inside apply()'s try/catch), but the double toast is confusing.

Skills loaded: ai-testing-core — AI generation/refinement NOT re-run this iteration per review-request directive (already verified iterations 1-2, 2-3 min single-concurrency).

ui_bugs.issue: When a paste contains invalid content (e.g. malformed predecessors), the 'Invalid link syntax' error toast and the 'Pasted N row(s)' success toast are BOTH shown because toast.success runs after apply() regardless of whether apply's try/catch swallowed a validation error. Cell values are correctly protected (unchanged), but the mixed toast messaging is misleading. Recommendation: track whether apply() succeeded and only fire the success toast when at least one edit landed, or move the success toast inside apply() on the happy path.

critical_code_review_comments: DataGrid.onPaste: toast.success('Pasted N row(s)') fires even when apply() catches a validation error, producing a false-positive success next to the error toast. Guard the toast on the result of apply().

DataGrid.onKeyDown Ctrl+D: fills sel.r1+1..r2 with cellValue(activities[range.r1], col). Uses the visually-top row of the range as the source regardless of the drag direction, which is the expected spreadsheet convention. Note: for milestone rows the backend correctly clamps duration to 0 after recalc — this is not a UI bug but worth documenting so users aren't surprised when a filled '55' shows as '0' on a milestone (e.g. A1040).

Workspace.jsx window keydown effect re-registers on every activities change; effect deps only lists implicit activities via undo/redo closures. useCallback-wrapped undo/redo would let you drop the eslint-disable comment and make behaviour more predictable under React strict mode.

Workspace.jsx reorder() pushes onto past.current before mutating activities but does NOT call recalc — it only sets local activities+dirty. That means dates/float shown after a drag are stale until the next edit. To match the 'schedule recalculates' promise for reorder in the review request, consider passing next through recalc(next,{history:false}) after the push (the drag itself doesn't change logic, but stripComputed order might affect predecessor lookup order in the backend if any).

Workspace.jsx dirty flag persists even after an undo that returns activities exactly to their pre-edit state (dirty is only cleared inside ingest()). Cosmetic: UNSAVED indicator remains lit after full-loop undo. Consider clearing dirty when past.current becomes empty and current activities equal the last-ingested snapshot.

DataGrid.onKeyDown treats mod+key as 'typing char' filter last (if (!mod && !e.altKey && e.key.length === 1)). Good. But it doesn't handle Ctrl+A (select all rows/cols) — a common spreadsheet expectation.
DataGrid draft-input onKeyDown stops propagation for every key (e.stopPropagation()), preventing Escape/Enter from bubbling to any parent handlers — correct.
action_items: (Low) DataGrid.jsx onPaste: only show 'Pasted N row(s)' toast on success — currently fires alongside the parseValue error toast on invalid paste content.
(Optional / cosmetic) Workspace.jsx: clear dirty flag when undo returns to the last-saved snapshot; call recalc after row reorder so the schedule/float reflects the new order immediately.
(Optional) Consider adding Ctrl+A range-select and Escape-to-clear-selection to round out the spreadsheet UX.

success_rate.backend: 100% (34/34 pytest smoke, AI suite skipped per brief)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (all iteration-3 grid/undo behaviours + all regression flows pass; 1 low-severity double-toast on invalid paste)

seed_data_creation: Reused seeded project ed60c71a-2483-4e54-b062-e9414efe35ce (Riverside Tower, 73 activities). All destructive edits were undone or Save-reverted; the final Save-cycle wrote back the original description for A1120. Later reorder + description edits in the last runs were left UNSAVED (never Save-clicked) so the persisted backend state is unchanged. Verified header still reads: 73 activities · 650wd · 2026-09-01 → 2029-03-23 · 20 critical · v6.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New iteration-3 data-testids: cellbox-{colKey}-{activityId} (td, click / shift-click / double-click target), cell-{colKey}-{activityId} (input/select in edit mode), undo-button, redo-button. Grid onKeyDown fires only when the grid div OR a cell has focus; the Workspace window keydown listener catches Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y / Ctrl+Shift+Z globally (unless target is INPUT/SELECT/TEXTAREA). Paste is best simulated by dispatching a ClipboardEvent with DataTransfer('text/plain', 'a\tb\nc\td') on the grid element rather than typing into an input. Clipboard permission (clipboard-read/write) must be granted via ctx.grant_permissions for navigator.clipboard writes to succeed silently. Ctrl+D fill leaves milestone rows at duration 0 because the backend recalculate step clamps milestone.duration=0 — this is correct product behaviour, not a bug. Backend pytest suite (34 tests) still fully green and takes ~5s.
rca_of_the_issue: The double-toast on invalid paste happens because DataGrid.onPaste does apply(edits) followed by an unconditional toast.success('Pasted N row(s)'). apply() internally catches any parseValue error via try/catch and shows toast.error(err.message), so the caller has no return value to test. Fix: make apply() return a boolean (or the number of successful edits) and gate the success toast on that, e.g. `const applied = apply(edits); if (applied) toast.success(...);`.
